brief: Posts today centered on agents and coding tools, including Fable 5.2 prompts, Guillermo Rauch's UI SDK demo, and subagent workflows. Amjad Masad's posts on recursive self-improvement and rare failures becoming daily events stood out beyond that.

themes.label: Agents and subagent workflows
themes.summary: Builders described agents reusing ready-made UI behaviors and delegating work from smart planning models to fast subagents.

themes.label: Fable and Claude Code setup
themes.summary: Builders shared prompts for auditing Claude Code setups and showed Fable in use for everyday tasks.

themes.label: Autonomy and system failures
themes.summary: Amjad Masad argued that autonomy in technology has long been increasing and that failures now happen daily as systems accelerate.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary: Argued that agents will improve fastest at coding and computer use, so more work will become coding-shaped. Also cited recent model examples generating animated videos, games and 3D models.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Shared two Claude Code prompts, /doctor prompt-audit and /claude-api prompt-audit, for auditing setups and skills after Fable 5.2. Also asked followers to star a repo.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Showed an agent building with the UI SDK, reusing 14 behaviors out of the box. Also said subagents work well, with projects planned by a smart model and delegated to fast ones.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Promoted the Every frontier feed of experiments and code. Also shared a Fable-written email and a writeup link.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Asked for feedback on Daybreak from the cyber team, covering models, codex plugins, access, documentation and red teaming.

builders.name: Garry Tan
builders.summary: Called Aside Browser a huge unlock for AI agents. Also called for modernizing the FAA and posted a short note about using gbrain.

builders.name: Josh Woodward
builders.summary: Announced Google Wallet connection in Gemini for personal finance insights, and said a feature is available to all Gemini app users in the USA.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Shared the 2026 Startup Bookshelf and joked about reading this week's incident reports. Mostly brief posts.

builders.name: Unsupervised Learning
builders.summary: Published Ep 97 with Jev Creator on decision models, benchmark fatigue, and why the labs missed it, including views on Anthropic valuation expectations.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Said AI UX is very suboptimal given models too cheap to meter. Other posts were brief and personal.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Posted that autonomous businesses are here and that technology has long been recursively self-improving, citing Douglas Engelbart. Also wrote that rare failures are now daily events.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Noted that NVIDIA is the one deep-pocketed player with a clear business interest in open weights AI, and asked what happens next.

builders.name: Peter Steinberger
builders.summary: Posted only a single emoji with a link, so no substantive content today.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Posted a single word, True, with a link. Only minor content today.
